sl_W0_ctl.source: die rst_n (asynchronous: the ONE root synchroniser)

note: OWNER DECISION 13 (2026-10-24): one root 2-flop synchroniser; neighbour wavefront; release = clocks after die rst_n deasserts at which the partition's taps (and its rst_o) release; the static schedule starts with an explicit start broadcast after reset

start.note: OWNER DECISION 13c: START rides the reset wavefront (start_i / start_o_<k> beside arst_n / rst_o_<k>, run relays on the reset relay sites).  Soft partition p's control state (leaves, boundary epochs, hard-core resets) releases at  max(release[p], S + release[p])  clocks, S = the die start pin's rising edge relative to rst_n deassert; i.e. the START offsets ARE the published release offsets.  Hard partitions (prebuilt, no start pin) see the raw reset only.
